dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: If only I could eat it again, it was so good...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Eat what again?

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: Oh, a traveler. When I was young I used to travel all over the place. What I loved most about traveling was getting to try all the different foods.

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: After eating my way across the continent, I returned to Liyue and opened my restaurant, Emerald Maple, in the hopes I could recreate the flavors of my travels.

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: But there's this one dish I can never quite remember the name of.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I get it.

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: All I remember is it was a sweet, fragrant dish. The sheer look of it was enough to get me drooling at the mouth... And to top it all off, it was nutritious too.

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: The ingredients are a lot of Fowl and some Sweet Flowers. It's called... Sweetened Mistress or something like that. If you'd be able to make one for me, I'd be ever so grateful.

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: Traveler — over to you!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What a tragedy!

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: *sigh* I've eaten such a wide variety of delicious foods in my time that I just can't remember what this one was...

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: You're back! Did you find the mystery dish?

response.speaker: Mr. Zhu
response.text: No problem. Take your time with the search... But please don't forget about it.

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: Thank you ever so much! Please take this for your trouble, traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: Just how am I going to recreate that flavor?

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: Greetings, esteemed guest! Are you here to put your feet up for a while, or are you checking in for a night or more?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Just passing by.

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: Uh... Great! That works too — care to stop in for a nice cup of hot tea or a bite to eat?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's pretty deserted here.

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: *sigh* Yeah, tell me about it... I should have listened to my old man and stayed at home, what am I doing, trying to run this inn out here...

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: I sure picked a bad spot to open an inn — it's right between Wangshu Inn and Liyue Harbor...

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: Travelers coming down from the north always pass by Wangshu Inn and end up stopping off there, and as for the travelers coming up from the south...

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: They pretty much only ever come up this way after drinking themselves into a stupor in Liyue Harbor...

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: ...*sigh* So it looks like I'm never going to have any guests here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you going to do about this place?

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: I'll keep it going as long as I can... If no one ends up staying here, I guess it'll be time for a not-so-grand closing; then I'll just sell off this god-forsaken place for whatever I can get.

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: It's just not possible to make a living in this line of work...

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: And I'm not exactly a top-tier talent. *sigh* There's nothing going for me... I guess I'll just have to go back home and take over the three jade mining facilities my old man left behind, and just try my best to get by in life.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: Take care!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd like to buy a snack.

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: Need a bite to eat? What can I get you?
